messages:
Marco: quick Q from the roadmap section — we got a ton of followups asking for clearer guidance on when to push Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private in sales conversations. can leadership share a short rubric?
Aisha: +1, good ask. high level: prioritize Hosted as default for speed/PLG. Dedicated when customer needs predictable throughput, capacity isolation, or committed pricing. Private for regulatory/air-gapped or strict KMS requirements.
Sana: do you have 2-3 bullets we can put in the sales playbook? reps keep asking for one-liners.
Aisha: yes — use this concise framing: 
```
Hosted: fastest time-to-value, pay-as-you-go, best for product-led adoption.
Dedicated: reserved GPUs, predictable latency & cost at scale, good for revenue-grade apps.
Private: VPC/on-prem, audit & KMS control, for regulated industries.
```
Aisha: also add a quick "when to escalate" note: if latency SLA < 100ms at steady throughput OR customer needs physical isolation -> propose Dedicated; if legal/regulatory controls OR must run in customer network -> propose Private.
Marco: perfect. are there any changes to prioritization on the roadmap? engineering asked if they should keep optimizing runtime for multi-tenant Hosted or focus on Dedicated perf wins.
Aisha: both matter but tier them: 1) invest to keep Hosted reliable + cost-competitive (PLG funnel impact), 2) Dedicated perf work (predictability for high-value contracts), 3) Private packaging and compliance automation.
Jon: can we be more concrete about "Dedicated perf work" — e.g., are we optimizing packing/batching or network topology first?
Aisha: short answer: batching and kernel selection first (biggest unit-economics wins), then routing & topology. Jon: noted.
Sana: for messaging, can we call out typical customer signals that indicate Dedicated/Private? examples help.
Aisha: sure:
- Dedicated signals: consistent high qps, budget for committed capacity, performance regressions on multi-tenant spikes, SLA requests.
- Private signals: compliance audits, contractual DB residency/KMS demands, legal + procurement blocking cloud endpoints.
Sana: this is great — I'll add to the playbook and share a one-slide summary. would also love a 2-3 line executive quote for the GTM deck, something crisp about where Redwood sits versus "model marketplaces" and "cloud infra".
Aisha: draft for deck: "Redwood makes serving predictable and economical — we remove the inference ops burden so product teams ship faster, whether they start on Hosted or scale into Dedicated and Private. We focus on production economics, not just model access."
Marco: nice. ops-bot: deploy notice for the all-hands recording link?
ops-bot: recording uploaded: https://redwood.slack/meeting-recordings/all-hands-2150004321 (auto-post)
Jon: one quick technical ask — can we add a short checklist for SRE/eng when we recommend Dedicated? I can draft and sync with platform.
Aisha: please do. include metrics to measure (p95 tail latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens) and recommended rollback/fallback policies (auto-fallback to compatible model variant in another region).
Sana: thanks leadership — super useful clarity. I'll circulate the updated playbook + slide before Monday. :thumbsup:
Marco: thanks everyone, will close loop once playbook update is live.
